affected_locations: Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS), Japan
key_impacts: Accident damaged the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant units, initiating a long-term decommissioning project.
Site moved from an emergency situation to a stabilized situation over time.
Large volumes of contaminated water required treatment and on-site storage (about 1,100,000 m3 by October 2018).
evidence_snippets: Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011
addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi ... from an emergency situation to a stabilized situation
